blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound difficult, but in English they follow simple patterns. In this lesson, we learn five useful words: invoice, receipt, form, folder and report. These words appear on Czarnikow's tax papers every month.

Sophie explains the tax words slowly, in simple English. She says the invoice must be correct before we send the form. The report stays in the fiscal folder for seven years, and we check every folder before the deadline.

Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. One small step at a time — with practice, they become easier. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: How many new words does the lesson teach?
items.why: "we learn five useful words: invoice, receipt, form, folder and report."

items.q: How long does the report stay in the fiscal folder?
items.why: "The report stays in the fiscal folder for seven years."

items.q: What must be correct before we send the form?
items.why: "the invoice must be correct before we send the form."

items.q: The text suggests that taxes are…
options: a normal part of the company's routine
items.why: Inferência: "Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine" — algo normal, não excepcional.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: the report can be thrown away quickly
English and taxes are too hard to learn
you should learn many words at once
practice makes taxes in English easier
items.why: Inferência: "One small step at a time… with practice, they become easier."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie descrevendo a mesa do contador antes da reunião fiscal. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning. Let me show you the accountant's desk before our tax meeting. There are many papers here today, but do not worry. It is simple.

There is a blue folder on the left. Inside the folder, there is one invoice and one receipt. The invoice is from last week. The receipt is small, but it is important, so we keep it.

In the middle of the desk, there is a form. The form is ready. The accountant only needs to check it and sign it.

On the right, there is the monthly report. It is not finished yet. There are two numbers to add before the deadline on Friday.

So, on the desk, there are two folders, one form and one report. That is all. One small step at a time, and we finish before Friday. You can do it!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is inside the blue folder?
items.why: "Inside the folder, there is one invoice and one receipt."

items.q: What is in the middle of the desk?
items.why: "In the middle of the desk, there is a form."

items.q: When is the deadline?
items.why: "two numbers to add before the deadline on Friday."

items.q: The report is not finished. What does this suggest?
options: There is still a little work to do before Friday
Sophie will not send the report
items.why: Inferência: faltam dois números — ainda há um pouco de trabalho, mas dá tempo antes de sexta.

items.q: How does Sophie want the listener to feel?
items.why: Inferência: "do not worry… One small step at a time… You can do it!" — tom calmo e encorajador.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We send the client an invoice at the end of the month." An invoice is…
options: a small paper that proves you paid
a bill that shows what to pay
items.why: Invoice = nota fiscal: o documento que mostra o que deve ser pago.

items.q: "Please keep the receipt after you pay." A receipt is…
items.why: Receipt = recibo: prova de que o pagamento foi feito.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The accountant must sign the tax ___ today."
items.why: Form = formulário: o documento fiscal que o contador assina.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "All the papers are in one green ___ on the desk."
items.why: Folder = pasta: onde os papéis ficam guardados.

items.q: "The team writes a monthly report for the manager." A report is…
options: a document with information and numbers
items.why: Report = relatório: documento com informações e números.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho fiscal. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager must sign off on the form." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final no documento.

items.q: "Please fill in the tax form." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher: escrever as informações no formulário.

items.q: "We must hand in the report on Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give it to the right person
items.why: Hand in = entregar o documento para quem o recebe.

items.q: "Let's check on the invoice before we pay." To check on means to…
options: look at it to be sure it is correct
items.why: Check on = verificar, conferir se está certo.

items.q: "We are almost done. Let's wrap up the folder." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = finalizar, terminar a tarefa.
